answer: Each new identity must post a refundable stake of 40 POA into a time-locked vault, and the required stake grows 25 percent for every identity already linked to the same signing device cohort. Unlocking takes 14 epochs, so a farm of ten fakes ties up roughly 600 POA for weeks, a horizon few attackers can afford. Validators verify the vault balance and lock height on chain, and an umber-flagged cohort is audited by random peers before any payout.
